description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'InterestRateChartSlabNotFoundException' used when a specific interest rate chart slab cannot be found. It extends the abstract exception class and provides constructors that pass error messages and identifiers for context.
external_methods: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Object... args)
